step.prompt: /crew-prd Write the PRD for the decision in docs/01. Do not ask questions; mark assumptions. Keep P0 small enough for a 3-minute demo. Write docs/03-prd.md and docs/04-requirements-traceability.md and finish.
step.judge: Read docs/03-prd.md and docs/04-requirements-traceability.md. Score 5 if personas have jobs and success moments, journeys are numbered steps, P0/P1/P2 are explicit with a one-sentence cut line, every FR/NFR is one testable 'must' sentence with a priority, metrics have targets, there is a constitution check, no technologies are named in requirements, and docs/04 has one row per requirement. Score 3 if IDs exist but requirements are vague or scope is not prioritised. Score 1 if it is a feature list.

judge.reason: docs/03 has a persona table with Job and Success moment columns, numbered J1–J3 journeys, §4.1–4.3 P0/P1/P2 with an explicit one-sentence 'Cut line', 40 FRs and 16 NFRs each one 'must' sentence with a Priority column and no named technologies, §7 metrics with targets, and a §8 constitution check; docs/04 has exactly one row per FR-001–040 and NFR-001–016.
